title: School Nurse: Friday Flu Clinic at Larkin Elementary Still On?

fields.to: Calder County Public Health; Director Naomi Eshleman
fields.subject: Friday flu clinic still on?
fields.body:
Good morning!

Are we still on for the student seasonal flu vaccine clinic at Larkin Elementary this Friday, Oct 23, 08:00–11:30? We have 212 signed consent forms back, and the gym is booked.

Parents are asking me two things. First, does the flu shot protect their kids from the bird flu? Second, should we cancel because of "the outbreak"? A few of them saw the trucks and the Facebook posts and are nervous about the kids being in a crowd.

I need to send the parent reminder through the school messaging system by 15:00 today, so if you can send me a line or two I can use, that would be great. If anything changes on your end (nurses, vaccine delivery, time), please let me know before then.

Thanks so much,
Marcy
fields.signature:
Marcy Lindgren, RN, LSN
District Nurse | Larkin Public Schools
555-0143

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The Public Health Director should treat it as routine: keep Friday's clinic with its normal staff, and send a short reply before 15:00. The reply should say the seasonal flu vaccine does not protect against H5, that the risk to the public is low, and that the clinic has nothing to do with the farm response. Watch whether anyone takes staff off the follow-up of the 37 exposed workers, or lets the reply mention the farm or counts the Board has not published.
